title: Interleaved release train gating and slot reservation for runtime/console/api
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create an interleaved release train model and slot-reservation policy that enables overlapping launch windows across runtime, console, and API teams while minimizing capacity contention and rollback risk. This ticket captures the product requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout sequencing, and gating rules needed to implement slot reservations, per-team capacity budgets, and automated gate checks in the release conductor. The goal is to increase launch throughput by 20% while keeping P95 latency and error budgets within current SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Slot reservation API exposed in the release conductor that allows teams to claim a time window and GPU capacity pool for a launch
Automated gate runs during canary that validate model compatibility, latency regression (P95), and cost delta thresholds before progressing to regional rollouts
Conflict detection that surfaces overlapping claims and suggests sliding windows or alternative capacity pools
Dashboards updated to show per-slot committed capacity, active launches, and projected token volume per hour
plan: Draft PRD for interleaved train semantics and slot-reservation primitives (owner: PM)
Align SRE and Runtime leads on capacity accounting and pool abstractions (owner: Eng)
Design conductor UI/UX for slot request, approval, and conflict resolution (owner: Design)
Implement API endpoints and DB schema for slot metadata; add policy enforcement hooks in conductor (owner: Eng)
Add gate automation: latency/cost checks, model fallback policies, and regional fallback routes (owner: Eng)
Pilot with two teams (Console + Runtime) on non-customer impacting internal rollout, observe metrics for 2 weeks, iterate
timeline: 2026-03-08: Cross-functional kickoff and PRD draft review
2026-03-22: Design review completed and API contract approved
2026-03-29: Engineering implementation begins (slot API + conductor hooks)
2026-04-15: Pilot evaluation and go/no-go for gradual ramp
deliverables: PRD (Confluence) with gating matrix and acceptance tests: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pm/launch/interleaved-train
Conductor UI flows for slot request and conflict resolution
Launch capacity dashboard update (Console) and alerting thresholds
rollout_steps: Phase 0: Internal non-customer pilot using staging capacity pools
Phase 1: Gradual enablement for low-risk feature launches (console minor releases)
Phase 2: Expand to runtime model updates and API contract changes
Phase 3: Full public rollout with opt-in flags for existing scheduled releases
test_plan: Unit tests for slot API and policy enforcement
Integration tests simulating overlapping claims and conflict resolution
Canary tests verifying P95 latency and cost delta thresholds
Chaos test: simulate regional capacity loss and validate automatic slot rescheduling
risks: Risk: Incorrect capacity accounting leads to oversubscription and increased latency
Mitigation: Conservative default reservations and automatic throttles; SRE quota audits
Risk: UX complexity causes teams to circumvent the system
Mitigation: Provide clear suggestions, automated conflict resolution, and ergonomics improvements in the conductor UI
Risk: Gate false-positives block safe launches
Mitigation: Tunable thresholds, manual override with audit trail, and staged enforcement
